evidence: Queries attribute-context status selector 0x13 and defaults to return 1 unless the low byte is 4. For status 4, calls f_700066cdf0 with a local pointer output; if the resolved pointer's byte at +0xa2 is set (using f_70018450e8 as a fallback when the pointer is null), calls f_70006abc34 and returns its low bit. Otherwise returns 1: decompiled/main/main_0093.c:34559-34588. No indexed caller is available.

Initializes the caller-provided output float to -1.0. If the global configuration/context path is present, resolves the player attribute object (calling f_700183f6e4 when the resolved pointer is null), reads selector 0x63 through accepted player_attribute_get_float, and stores the returned float to the output. If the global path is absent, leaves the -1.0 default: decompiled/main/main_0124.c:38671-38706; selector helper at 0x700183e8e0. No indexed caller is available.

Initializes the output to UINT32_MAX, then proceeds only when bit 28 of the loaded global configuration word is set. Resolves the context provider pointer (using f_700183f6e4 when null), reads nested selector 0x0c through accepted nested_attribute_provider_get_float, converts the float to signed int, and stores the result. If the flag is clear, leaves UINT32_MAX: decompiled/main/main_0124.c:12312-12347; provider helper at 0x700183eafc.

Initializes the output to UINT32_MAX and proceeds only when bit 26 of the loaded global configuration word is clear. Resolves the player attribute pointer (using f_700183f6e4 when null), reads selector 0x23 through accepted player_attribute_get_float, converts the float to signed int, and stores it. When bit 26 is set, leaves the sentinel unchanged: decompiled/main/main_0124.c:50071-50106; helper at 0x700183e8e0.

If the incoming pointer is nonnull, tail-calls the accepted initialize_season_record_detail_container helper with the original arguments; if null, returns without calling it: decompiled/main/main_0088.c:51382-51389; helper at 0x7000ce81e0. No indexed caller is available.
